info.title: Confera admin API
info.description: The API of the admin surface. It answers only under the admin host name.

default.description: Any error, in the one error format of the API (RFC 9457 problem details). An unexpected error carries `code` and `traceId` only.

get.summary: Name and version of the API.

path.description: Path of the field in the request, for example `authors.0.email`.

code.description: Stable code of the rule that failed, for example `isEmail`. Never the value.

version.description:
Version of the API (SemVer), the same as `info.version` of the OpenAPI document.
A client built for another major version must stop and ask for a reload.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable code, for example `not_found` or `validation_failed`.

traceId.description: Identifies this request in the server log.

status.description: HTTP status. Absent on an unknown error.

title.description: Short English name of the status. Absent on an unknown error.

errors.description: The refused fields, when the input was not valid.
